title: CodeAtlas Relationship Schema
description: Schema defining a directed connection or relationship between two entities in the codebase map.

source.description: The ID or file path of the source entity.

target.description: The ID or file path of the target entity.

relationship_type.description: The semantic category of the relationship.

description.description: Human-readable description of how or why these two nodes connect.

confidence.description: How certain we are that this connection is correct and complete.
